About the workshop
This one-day workshop introduces spreadsheets, Python and SQL to complete beginners. We will use Microsoft Excel for the first session, Python for the second, and Tableau for a short demo at the end. Bring a laptop with the free software installed. Lunch and tea are included.

What to bring
A laptop, a charger, and a notebook. Install Python and a text editor before you come. Wear comfortable clothes. Parking is available in the campus lot.

Fee and refund
The fee of 1,500 rupees has been received in full. Refunds are possible up to three days before the workshop. Write to the address above to ask for a refund.
